title: Lake Nyos: the lake that breathed out death

facts.claim: On 21 August 1986 Lake Nyos in Cameroon suddenly released a huge cloud of carbon dioxide
About 1,700 people and some 3,500 livestock in nearby villages died, many in their sleep
The lake sits in a volcanic crater; CO2 from below had built up dissolved in its deep water
Since 2001 degassing pipes have been installed to release the gas safely

opening.label: LAKE NYOS · CAMEROON
opening.why: A remote crater lake almost nobody could place; seeing where it is sets up the surprise.

music_mood: quiet dread: low drone, sparse pulse, one deep hit at the eruption

headline: THE LAKE THAT
KILLED 1,700
cover.hook_voiceover_ml: തീയില്ല. വെള്ളപ്പൊക്കമില്ല. ശബ്ദം പോലുമില്ല. എന്നിട്ടും ഒറ്റ രാത്രിയിൽ 1,700 പേർ മരിച്ചു.
cover.visual: A still crater lake at dusk between green hills, perfectly calm, with a faint mist starting to rise from its surface.
cover.build_cmd: Sky gradient from #1a2a4a (top) to #c86a4a (horizon at y0.42). Two layers of rounded green hills (#1e3a2a front, #2e5a3a back) framing a lake: an ellipse x0.5 y0.52, 820x260, fill gradient #1f3a4a to #0b1a26 with 8 slow horizontal ripple lines. From 40% a thin white mist layer (semi-transparent ellipses, opacity rising to 0.35) drifts over the lake surface. A few tiny village house silhouettes on the left hill. Everything calm and slow; reserve the bottom 25% for the cover text.

scenes.voiceover_ml: കാമറൂണിലെ ന്യോസ്. ഒരു അഗ്നിപർവ്വത ഗർത്തത്തിലെ ശാന്തമായ തടാകം.
scenes.headline: A CRATER LAKE
scenes.visual: Cross-section of the crater: a bowl of rock holding the lake, with a village on the rim.
scenes.build_cmd: Side-view cross-section: rock mass (#3a2e26) filling the lower half with a bowl-shaped cut; the bowl holds water (gradient #2a5a6a top to #0c1c26 bottom) from y0.36 to y0.62 between x0.2 and x0.8. On the right rim, 4 small houses; on the left rim, 3 trees. Draw it in with a left-to-right reveal wipe over the first 30%. Then a faint dotted line labels the water depth (vertical dashed line at x0.5 from surface to bottom, appears at 50%).

scenes.voiceover_ml: പക്ഷേ അതിന്റെ അടിയിൽ, വർഷങ്ങളായി കാർബൺ ഡൈ ഓക്സൈഡ് അലിഞ്ഞു കൂടുകയായിരുന്നു.
scenes.headline: GAS BUILDING BELOW
scenes.visual: Same cross-section; from cracks in the crater floor, bubbles of gas seep up and dissolve into the deep water, which slowly tints darker.
scenes.build_cmd: Reuse the cross-section layout. Three cracks in the crater floor (thin dark zigzags). From them, 40 small bubbles rise slowly (deterministic paths, speed 60px/s) and fade out before reaching mid-depth. The deep half of the water gradually tints from #0c1c26 to #2a1420 over the scene (gas saturation), and a thin red 'pressure' bar on the right (x0.86, from y0.62 up to y0.36) fills from 0 to 90% with the accent colour.

scenes.voiceover_ml: 1986 ഓഗസ്റ്റ് 21, രാത്രി. ആ വാതകം മുഴുവൻ ഒറ്റയടിക്ക് പൊട്ടി പുറത്തേക്ക്.
scenes.headline: 21 AUGUST 1986
scenes.visual: The lake surface erupts in a fountain of gas; a heavy white cloud spills over the rim and flows downhill into the valley like liquid.
scenes.build_cmd: Night version of the cross-section (sky #060a14). At 20% the water surface bulges upward (ellipse scaling) and at 28% bursts: 60 spray particles shoot up and fall. From 30% a thick white-grey cloud (stack of soft ellipses, opacity 0.85) rises from the lake, spills over the LEFT rim and flows down the slope to the bottom-left corner over 50-95% of the scene, hugging the ground. House windows on the rim go from warm yellow to dark as the cloud passes. One deep screen flash (white, 0.15 opacity, 0.2 s) at the burst.

scenes.voiceover_ml: വായുവിനേക്കാൾ ഭാരമുള്ള വാതകം താഴ്വരകളിൽ നിറഞ്ഞു. ഉറങ്ങിക്കിടന്നവർക്ക് ശ്വാസം കിട്ടിയില്ല.
scenes.headline: HEAVIER THAN AIR
scenes.visual: A simple diagram: the invisible gas pools in the low valley like water filling a bowl; sleeping village outlines sit inside the pool.
scenes.build_cmd: Valley diagram: a wide U-shaped ground line (dark) from x0.05 to x0.95 dipping to y0.6 in the middle. A translucent grey 'pool' fills the valley from the bottom up (level rises from y0.62 to y0.44 over 10-60%, wavy top edge). Inside the valley, 6 tiny house outlines. No people drawn. At 60% a thin horizontal rule and the label appear; the pool keeps gently sloshing. Keep it quiet and restrained; no flashing.

scenes.voiceover_ml: ഇന്ന് പൈപ്പുകൾ വഴി ആ വാതകം പതുക്കെ പുറത്തുവിടുന്നു. കാരണം ആ തടാകം കൊല്ലുന്നത്, ഒരു ശബ്ദവുമില്ലാതെയാണ്.
scenes.headline: DEGASSING THE LAKE
scenes.visual: Daytime lake with a vertical pipe from the surface to the bottom; a tall fountain of water and gas shoots up safely from its top.
scenes.build_cmd: Daylight cross-section (sky #6aa7d8). A vertical pipe (14px wide, grey) from a float at the surface (x0.5 y0.44) down to y0.7. From 25% a fountain erupts from the pipe top: a white column rising to y0.2 with 40 droplet particles arcing outward; the deep water tint lightens from #2a1420 back to #0c1c26 over the scene; the red pressure bar on the right empties from 90% to 10%. End on a calm, bright frame.

instagram_caption:
One night in 1986, a lake killed about 1,700 people, silently. 🌊

Lake Nyos in Cameroon sits in a volcanic crater. Carbon dioxide from below had been building up in its deep water for years, until it burst out as a huge invisible cloud. Heavier than air, it flowed into the valleys where people slept. Today pipes release the gas safely. 🧪
